caption:
Skip midday at Tokyo's Senso-ji 🏮
Go early, or after dinner, for no crowds.

🥇 Early morning

🚶 The temple grounds never close.

🏮 Walk Nakamise before the shops open.

⛩️ Step inside the main hall in peace.

🍲 Then a miso soup breakfast
at MISOJYU, a short walk away.

🥈 After dinner

✨ The gates, pagoda and main hall are lit up.

🖼️ The closed shops show painted shutters.

📸 The hall is shut at night,
so this visit is for photos and a slow walk.

💡 For the view down Nakamise,
go up to the free 8th-floor terrace
of the tourist centre opposite Kaminarimon.

💬 Comment SENSOJI for our free guide to Senso-ji,
including a miso soup breakfast
and a comedy theatre with rakugo
(comic storytelling) every day of the year.
